items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I love playing with him. He’s my favorite horn player to play with, period, hands down, period, still.

ctx.x: I love playing with him. He’s my favorite horn player to play with, period, hands down, period, still.
And for somebody – a trumpet player in his mid-’60s to really have his chops totally happening is pretty amazing.
